Direction inferred as long from averaging down after dips and take profit above entry; no explicit long/short stated.
'drops below 28' compiled as crosses_below rather than holding below 28.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Take profit 3% above average (DCA) entry cannot be expressed because average entry depends on the unmodeled ladder; no fixed-percentage target from base entry is used.
